WHILE others chant of gay Elysian scenes,
Of balmy zephyrs, and of flow'ry plains,
My song more happy speaks a greater name,

They shall see Him 'mid the murmurs
Of zephyrs soft and bland.
zephyr: Little hands, veined like young leaves; voice like the breath of a zephyr.
Hushed are the winds and still the evening gloom, Not e’en a Zephyr wanders through the grove, Whilst I return to view my Margaret’s tomb And scatter flowers on the dust I love.

Good night! which put the candle out?
A jealous zephyr, not a doubt.
